data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 places unimported functions (Priority 4) above torn-tail repair gate (Priority 5), classifying the latter as merely a 'partial coverage gap' while routing rot is called 'high' enough to outrank it. But the problem's blast-radius principle ranks record-corruption defects above routing/refusal-hiding ones; a torn-tail repair gate failure directly corrupts the append-only record, whereas unimported functions at best hide mis-routing and SRC_001 itself concedes 'neither corrupts the append-only record nor bypasses a security policy.' Under the stated criterion, a record-integrity gap cannot sit below a routing-rot gap, so the ordering contradicts the problem's scoring rule.
